verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a product-data API, and a platform like this could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring jobs, so the axis applies. The evidence documents no way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows. Price-tracking subscriptions with webhook notifications are event-driven alerts on price changes, not a user-defined recurring schedule, so they are only an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
